notes: PMK 48/PMK.03/2023 (28 Apr 2023, eff. 1 May 2023) on the DJP portal: Pasal 14(3)(b) jewellery VAT to end consumer 15% x 11% = 1.65% (1.1% trade-to-trade). Bullion VAT not collected if bar form, min. 99.99%, certified (DJP article; PMK 48 Pasal 20 defers non-reserve bullion to PP 49/2022). Import duty and Antam buyback removed round 1 (news-only); see ID upgrade PR. Making null.

sources.name: Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) - Full text of PMK 48/PMK.03/2023 on gold jewellery and bullion
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: Pasal 14(3)(b) jewellery VAT to end consumer 15% x 11% = 1.65% of selling price; Pasal 14(3)(a)/(4)(a) 10% x 11% = 1.1% trade-to-trade; Pasal 14(4)(c) 0% to manufacturers
